thread:
kevin: Heads up 1: my consulate appointment for H-1B stamping got canceled due to local embassy closure (storms). Offer start is Oct 1. If stamping slips into October, will benefits or PTO be affected?

maria (People Ops): Short answer: benefits/PTO require active payroll and completed I-9. If youre not authorized on payroll by the cutoff we cant enroll you.

kevin: Any workaround? Im in transit and could go to a different consulate in early Oct. Can Redwood accept a scanned approval + I-797 for remote I-9 in the meantime?

elisabeth (Immigration): Yes, scanned PDFs of I-797 or approval notice can be used for remote verification temporarily. Originals must be inspected by an authorized representative when you return to the US. If you have a pending change-of-status with cap-gap language, upload the I-797C receipt.

payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoff is Sept 25 for Oct payroll. If authorization docs arrive and are verified before cutoff we can try to backdate hire date; otherwise payroll will start in the next cycle.

kevin: If I join Oct 1 as onboarding-only (no pay), will my manager be able to add me to the training cohort?

it-ops: Yes  onboarding-only gets email/Slack/LMS. Hardware before payroll requires manager signoff and will be processed as an asset loan.

maria (People Ops): Action items: @kevin upload any appointment emails and passport scan to the portal; @elisabeth will draft a travel letter you can present at the consulate; payroll to hold off unless docs are verified by cutoff.

elisabeth (Immigration): Travel letter template below. Send consulate location and Ill sign.

``
To: Consular Officer
Subject: Employment verification for visa stamping
Name: Kevin Tran
Position: Software Engineer
Proposed start: October 1, 2026
Employer: Redwood Inference, Inc.
We confirm the above-named individual has a bona fide job offer. Contact hr@redwood.com for verification.
``

kevin: Uploaded the cancellation notice and passport scan. Thanks all :pray:

maria (People Ops): Received. We'll provision onboarding-only access Oct 1 and hold benefits/payroll until I-9 originals or cap-gap docs are provided. Will update this thread if we can backdate after payroll cutoff.
